title: EtherVerse: Cosmic Ethereum
tagline: EtherVerse: Cosmic Ethereum, generative art NFT collection showcases visually stunning representations of Ethereum's role in the multiverse using Highlight.xyz's Generative Series feature.
description:
Explore the interstellar realm where Ethereum reigns supreme as the cosmic hub connecting Earth and multiple parallel universes. This generative art NFT collection captures the Ethereum community's essence and ETHGlobal's mission by showcasing visually stunning representations of Ethereum's pivotal role in the vast expanse of the multiverse. This project focuses on the use of Highlight.xyz's new Generative Series feature exclusive to ETHGlobal Waterloo.

Immerse yourself in the celestial beauty and creative diversity of "EtherVerse: Cosmic Ethereum," where blockchain data inputs intertwine with artistic brilliance to redefine the boundaries of decentralized imagination.
how_its_made: This project, EtherVerse: Cosmic Ethereum, use Highlight's Generative Series feature to mint and deploy our NFT collection. For our tech stack, we used Javascript, HTML, and crucially P5.js to create our artwork and then Highlight to share EtherVerse: Cosmic Ethereum with the world.
